summary: Aurora Cannabis filed a 6-K on Nov 5, 2026, reporting Q2 FY2027 results and disclosing its Nov 3 definitive arrangement agreement to be acquired by Organigram Global. Each Aurora share converts, subject to proration, into C$7.80 cash, 5.8626 Organigram shares, or C$3.75 cash plus 3.0431 Organigram shares, structured as a BC statutory plan of arrangement. Closing is expected January 2027, subject to shareholder, court and regulatory approvals; a special meeting is expected December 2026. The US equivalent is a merger. Watch proration elections, regulatory timing and closing risk.
